description:
Perform quantitative DNA content analysis on a fluorescence microscopy image of human cancer cells.

Input: ~/Fiji_Data/raw/cell_cycle/nuclei.tif (DAPI stained nuclei)

Steps:
1. Open the image and apply Background Subtraction (Rolling Ball radius: 50 pixels).
2. Segment nuclei using the Otsu threshold method. Apply Watershed to separate touching cells.
3. Measure the 'Integrated Density' of all particles (filter size: 100-Infinity).
4. Analyze the distribution of Integrated Density values to identify the G1 phase peak (the most common value/mode).
5. Save results:
   - Measurements table: ~/Fiji_Data/results/cell_cycle/measurements.csv
   - Histogram plot: ~/Fiji_Data/results/cell_cycle/histogram.png
   - Text report: ~/Fiji_Data/results/cell_cycle/g1_peak_report.txt (must contain the numeric value of the G1 peak integrated density)

Goal: Accurately identify the G1 population intensity.
